Amr-e-Ilaahi aa gaya hai, lihaaza ab bila-wajah jaldi na machaao ke Khuda un ke shirk se paak o paakeeza aur buland o baala hai
Woh jis bande par chaahta hai apne hukm se malaaika ko rooh ke saath naazil kar deta hai ke un bandon ko daraao aur samjhaao ke mere ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, lihaaza mujhi se darein
Usi Khuda ne zameen o aasmaan ko haq ke saath paida kiya hai, aur woh un ke shareekon se bahut buland o baala-tar hai
Us ne insaan ko ek qatra-e-najis se paida kiya hai, magar phir bhi woh khullam khulla jhagda karne waala ho gaya hai
Aur usi ne chaupaayon ko bhi paida kiya hai jin mein tumhaare liye garm libaas aur deegar manaafe ka saamaan hai, aur ba'z ko to tum khaate bhi ho
Aur tumhaare liye unhi jaanwaron mein se zeenat ka saamaan hai jab tum shaam ko inhein waapas laate ho aur subah ko charaagaah ki taraf le jaate ho

Aur yeh haiwaanaat tumhaare bojh ko utha kar un shehron tak le jaate hain jahaan tak tum jaan jokhon mein daale baghair nahin pahunch sakte the. Beshak tumhaara Parwardigar bada shafeeq aur meharbaan hai
Aur us ne ghode, khachchar aur gadhe ko paida kiya taake un par sawaari karo aur unhein zeenat bhi qaraar do, aur woh aisi cheezon ko bhi paida karta hai jin ka tumhein ilm bhi nahin hai
Aur darmiyaani raaste ki hidaayat Khuda ki apni zimmedaari hai, aur ba'z raaste kaj bhi hote hain, aur woh chaahta to tum sab ko zabardasti raah-e-raast par le aata
Woh wahi Khuda hai jis ne aasmaan se paani naazil kiya hai jis ka ek hissa peene waala hai aur ek hisse se darakht paida hote hain jin se tum jaanwaron ko charaate ho
Woh tumhaare liye zaraa'at, zaitoon, khurme, angoor aur tamaam phal isi paani se paida karta hai. Is amr mein bhi saahibaan-e-fikr ke liye us ki qudrat ki nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Aur usi ne tumhaare raat din aur aaftaab o maahtaab sab ko musakhkhar kar diya hai, aur sitaare bhi usi ke hukm ke taabe' hain. Beshak is mein bhi saahibaan-e-aql ke liye qudrat ki bahut si nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain
Aur jo kuch tumhaare liye is zameen ke andar mukhtalif rangon mein paida kiya hai us mein bhi ibrat haasil karne waali qaum ke liye us ki nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Aur wahi woh hai jis ne samandaron ko musakhkhar kiya hai taake tum us mein se taaza gosht kha sako aur pehenne ke liye zeenat ka saamaan nikaal sako, aur tum to dekh rahe ho ke kashtiyaan kis tarah us ke seene ko cheerti hui chali ja rahi hain, aur yeh sab is liye bhi hai ke tum us ke fazl o karam ko talaash kar sako, aur shaayad isi tarah us ke shukr-guzaar bande bhi ban jaao
Aur us ne zameen mein pahaadon ke langar daal diye taake tumhein le kar apni jagah se hat na jaaye, aur nahrein aur raaste bana diye taake manzil-e-safar mein hidaayat pa sako
Aur alaamaat mu'ayyan kar deen, aur log sitaaron se bhi raaste daryaaft kar lete hain
Kya aisa paida karne waala un ke jaisa ho sakta hai jo kuch nahin paida kar sakte? Aakhir tumhein hosh kyon nahin aa raha hai
Aur tum Allah ki ne'maton ko shumaar bhi karna chaaho to nahin kar sakte ho, beshak Allah bada meharbaan aur bakhshne waala hai
Aur Allah hi tumhaare baatin o zaahir dono se baakhabar hai
Aur us ke ilaawa jinhein yeh mushrikeen pukaarte hain woh khud hi makhlooq hain, aur woh kisi cheez ko khalq nahin kar sakte hain
Woh to murda hain, un mein zindagi bhi nahin hai, aur na inhein yeh khabar hai ke murde kab uthaaye jaayenge
Tumhaara khuda sirf ek hai, aur jo log aakhirat par imaan nahin rakhte hain un ke dil munkir qism ke hain aur woh khud maghroor o mutakabbir hain
Yaqeenan Allah un tamaam baaton ko jaanta hai jinhein yeh chhupaate hain ya jin ka izhaar karte hain, woh mutakabbireen ko hargiz pasand nahin karta hai
Aur jab un se poochha jaata hai ke tumhaare Parwardigar ne kya kya naazil kiya hai to kehte hain ke yeh sab pichhle logon ke afsaane hain
Taake yeh mukammal taur par apna bhi bojh uthaayein aur apne un mureedon ka bhi bojh uthaayein jinhein bila-ilm o fehm ke gumraah karte rahe hain. Beshak yeh bada badtareen bojh uthaane waale hain

Yaqeenan un se pehle waalon ne bhi makkaariyaan ki thin, to azaab-e-Ilaahi un ki ta'meeraat tak aaya aur use jad se ukhaad phenka, aur un ke saron par chhat gir padi, aur azaab aise andaaz se aaya ke inhein sha'oor bhi na paida ho saka

Us ke baad woh roz-e-qiyaamat inhein ruswa karega aur poochhega ke kahaan hain woh mere shareek jin ke baare mein tum jhagda kiya karte the? Us waqt saahibaan-e-ilm kahenge ke aaj ruswaai aur buraai in kaafiron ke liye saabit ho gayi hai

Jinhein malaaika is aalam mein uthaate hain ke woh apne nafs ke zaalim hote hain, to us waqt itaa'at ki pesh-kash karte hain ke hum to koi buraai nahin karte the. Beshak Khuda khoob jaanta hai ke tum kya kya karte the
Jaao ab Jahannam ke darwaazon se daakhil ho jaao aur hamesha wahin raho, ke mutakabbireen ka thikaana bahut bura hota hai

Aur jab saahibaan-e-taqwa se kaha gaya ke tumhaare Parwardigar ne kya naazil kiya hai to unhon ne kaha ke sab khair hai. Beshak jin logon ne is duniya mein nek aamaal kiye hain un ke liye neki hai, aur aakhirat ka ghar to bahar-haal behtar hai, aur woh muttaqeen ka behtareen makaan hai

Wahaan hamesha rehne waale baaghaat hain jin mein yeh log daakhil honge, aur un ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi, woh jo kuch chaahenge sab un ke liye haazir hoga, ke Allah isi tarah un saahibaan-e-taqwa ko jaza deta hai
Jinhein malaaika is aalam mein uthaate hain ke woh paak o paakeeza hote hain, aur un se malaaika kehte hain ke tum par salaam ho, ab tum apne nek aamaal ki bina par Jannat mein daakhil ho jaao

Kya yeh log sirf is baat ka intezaar kar rahe hain ke un ke paas malaaika aa jaayein ya hukm-e-Parwardigar aa jaaye? To yahi un ke pehle waalon ne bhi kiya tha, aur Allah ne un par koi zulm nahin kiya hai, balke yeh khud hi apne nafs par zulm karte rahe hain
Nateeja yeh hua ke un ke aamaal ke bure asaraat un tak pahunch gaye, aur jin baaton ka yeh mazaaq udaaya karte the unhi baaton ne inhein apne ghere mein le liya aur phir tabaah o barbaad kar diya

Aur mushrikeen kehte hain ke agar Khuda chaahta to hum ya hamaare buzurg us ke ilaawa kisi ki ibaadat na karte aur na us ke hukm ke baghair kisi shai ko haraam qaraar dete. Isi tarah un ke pehle waalon ne bhi kiya tha, to kya rasoolon ki zimmedaari waazeh e'laan ke ilaawa kuch aur bhi hai

Aur yaqeenan hum ne har ummat mein ek rasool bheja hai ke tum log Allah ki ibaadat karo aur taaghoot se ijtinaab karo. Phir un mein ba'z ko Khuda ne hidaayat de di aur ba'z par gumraahi saabit ho gayi, to ab tum log roo-e-zameen mein sair karo aur dekho ke takzeeb karne waalon ka anjaam kya hota hai
Agar aap ko khwaahish hai ke yeh hidaayat pa jaayein to Allah jis ko gumraahi mein chhod chuka hai ab use hidaayat nahin de sakta, aur na un ka koi madad karne waala hoga

Un logon ne waaqai Allah ki qasam khaayi thi ke Allah marne waalon ko dobaara zinda nahin kar sakta hai, haalaanke yeh us ka barhaq waada hai, yeh aur baat hai ke aksar log is haqeeqat se baakhabar nahin hain
Woh chaahta hai ke logon ke liye us amr ko waazeh kar de jis mein woh ikhtilaaf kar rahe hain, aur kuffaar ko yeh maaloom ho jaaye ke woh waaqai jhooth bola karte the
Hum jis cheez ka iraada kar lete hain us se faqat itna kehte hain ke ho ja, aur phir woh ho jaati hai

Aur jin logon ne zulm sehne ke baad raah-e-Khuda mein hijrat ikhtiyaar ki hai hum anqareeb duniya mein bhi un ko behtareen maqaam ata karenge, aur aakhirat ka ajr to yaqeenan bahut bada hai, agar yeh log is haqeeqat se baakhabar hon
Yahi woh log hain jinhon ne sabr kiya hai aur apne Parwardigar par bharosa karte rahe hain
Aur hum ne aap se pehle bhi mardon hi ko rasool bana kar bheja hai aur un ki taraf bhi wahi karte rahe hain, to un se kahiye ke agar tum nahin jaante ho to jaanne waalon se daryaaft karo

Aur hum ne un rasoolon ko mo'jizaat aur kitaabon ke saath bheja hai, aur aap ki taraf bhi zikr (Quran) ko naazil kiya hai taake un ke liye un ahkaam ko waazeh kar dein jo un ki taraf naazil kiye gaye hain, aur shaayad yeh is baare mein kuch ghaur o fikr karein

Kya yeh buraaiyon ki tadbeerein karne waale kuffaar is baat se mutma'in ho gaye hain ke Allah achaanak inhein zameen mein dhansa de, ya un tak is tarah azaab aa jaaye ke inhein us ka sha'oor bhi na ho
Ya inhein chalte phirte giraftaar kar liya jaaye, ke yeh Allah ko aajiz nahin kar sakte hain
Ya phir inhein dara dara kar dheere dheere giraft mein liya jaaye, ke tumhaara Parwardigar bada shafeeq aur meharbaan hai
Kya un logon ne un makhlooqaat ko nahin dekha hai jin ka saaya daahine baayein palatta rehta hai, ke sab usi ki baargaah mein tawaazo' o inkisaar ke saath sajda-rez hain
Aur Allah hi ke liye aasmaan ki tamaam cheezein aur zameen ke tamaam chalne waale aur malaaika sajda-rez hain, aur koi istikbaar karne waala nahin hai
Yeh sab apne Parwardigar ki bartari aur azmat se khaufzada hain aur usi ke amr ke mutaabiq kaam kar rahe hain
Aur Allah ne keh diya hai ke khabardaar do khuda na banaao, ke Allah sirf Khuda-e-Waahid hai, lihaaza mujh hi se daro
Aur usi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki har shai hai, aur usi ke liye daaimi itaa'at bhi hai, to kya tum ghair-e-Khuda se bhi darte ho
Aur tumhaare paas jo bhi ne'mat hai woh sab Allah hi ki taraf se hai, aur us ke baad bhi jab tumhein koi takleef chhoo leti hai to tum usi se faryaad karte ho
Aur jab woh takleef ko door kar deta hai to tum mein se ek giroh apne Parwardigar ka shareek banaane lagta hai
Taake un ne'maton ka inkaar kar dein jo hum ne inhein ata ki hain. Khair, chand roz aur maze kar lo, us ke baad anjaam maaloom hi ho jaaega
Aur yeh hamaare diye hue rizq mein se un ka bhi hissa qaraar dete hain jinhein jaante bhi nahin hain, to anqareeb tum se tumhaare iftira ke baare mein bhi sawaal kiya jaaega
Aur yeh Allah ke liye ladkiyaan qaraar dete hain jab ke woh paak aur be-niyaaz hai, aur yeh jo kuch chaahte hain woh sab unhi ke liye hai
Aur jab khud un mein se kisi ko ladki ki bashaarat di jaati hai to us ka chehra siyaah pad jaata hai aur woh khoon ke ghoont peene lagta hai
Qaum se munh chhupaata hai ke bahut buri khabar sunaayi gayi hai. Ab is ko zillat samet zinda rakhe ya khaak mein mila de? Yaqeenan yeh log bahut bura faisla kar rahe hain
Jin logon ko aakhirat par imaan nahin hai un ki misaal badtareen misaal hai, aur Allah ke liye behtareen misaal hai, ke wahi saahib-e-izzat aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Agar Khuda logon se un ke zulm ka muwaakhaza karne lagta to roo-e-zameen par ek rengne waale ko bhi na chhodta, lekin woh sab ko ek mu'ayyan muddat tak ke liye dheel deta hai. Us ke baad jab waqt aa jaaega to phir na ek saa'at ki taakheer hogi aur na taqdeem

Yeh Khuda ke liye woh qaraar dete hain jo khud apne liye naapasand karte hain, aur un ki zabaanein yeh ghalat-bayaani bhi karti hain ke aakhirat mein un ke liye neki hai, haalaanke yaqeeni taur par un ke liye Jahannam hai, aur yeh sab se pehle hi daale jaayenge

Allah ki apni qasam! Ke hum ne tum se pehle mukhtalif qaumon ki taraf rasool bheje to Shaitaan ne un ke kaarobaar ko un ke liye aaraasta kar diya, aur wahi aaj bhi un ka sarparast hai, aur un ke liye bahut bada dardnaak azaab hai

Aur hum ne aap par kitaab sirf is liye naazil ki hai ke aap un masaail ki wazaahat kar dein jin mein yeh ikhtilaaf kiye hue hain, aur yeh kitaab saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye mujassama-e-hidaayat aur rehmat hai
Aur Allah hi ne aasmaan se paani barsaaya hai aur us ke zariye zameen ko murda hone ke baad dobaara zinda kiya hai, is mein bhi baat sunne waali qaum ke liye nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Aur tumhaare liye haiwaanaat mein bhi ibrat ka saamaan hai, ke hum un ke shikam se gobar aur khoon ke darmiyaan se khaalis doodh nikaalte hain jo peene waalon ke liye intehaai khush-gawaar maaloom hota hai
Aur phir khurme aur angoor ke phalon se woh sheera nikaalte hain jis se tum nasha aur behtareen rizq sab kuch tayyaar kar lete ho, is mein bhi saahibaan-e-aql ke liye nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain
Aur tumhaare Parwardigar ne shahad ki makkhi ko ishaara diya ke pahaadon aur darakhton aur gharon ki bulandiyon mein apne ghar banaaye

Us ke baad mukhtalif phalon se ghiza haasil kare aur narmi ke saath Khudaai raaste par chale, jis ke baad us ke shikam se mukhtalif qism ke mashroob baraamad honge jis mein poore aalam-e-insaaniyat ke liye shifa ka saamaan hai, aur is mein bhi fikr karne waali qaum ke liye ek nishaani hai

Aur Allah hi ne tumhein paida kiya hai, phir wahi wafaat deta hai, aur ba'z logon ko itni badtareen umr tak palta diya jaata hai ke ilm ke baad bhi kuch jaanne ke qaabil na reh jaayein. Beshak Allah har shai ka jaanne waala aur har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai

Aur Allah hi ne ba'z ko rizq mein ba'z par fazeelat di hai, to jin ko behtar banaaya gaya hai woh apna baqiyya rizq un ki taraf nahin palta dete hain jo un ke haathon ki milkiyat hain, haalaanke rizq mein sab baraabar ki haisiyat rakhne waale hain. To kya yeh log Allah hi ki ne'mat ka inkaar kar rahe hain

Aur Allah ne tum hi mein se tumhaara joda banaaya hai, phir us jode se aulaad qaraar di hai, aur sab ko paakeeza rizq diya hai. To kya yeh log baatil par imaan rakhte hain aur Allah hi ki ne'mat se inkaar karte hain
Aur yeh log Allah ko chhod kar un ki ibaadat karte hain jo na aasmaan o zameen mein kisi rizq ke maalik hain aur na kisi cheez ki taaqat hi rakhte hain
To khabardaar Allah ke liye misaalein bayaan na karo ke Allah sab kuch jaanta hai aur tum kuch nahin jaante ho

Allah ne khud us ghulaam-e-mamlook ki misaal bayaan ki hai jo kisi cheez ka ikhtiyaar nahin rakhta hai, aur us aazaad insaan ki misaal bayaan ki hai jise hum ne behtareen rizq ata kiya hai aur woh us mein se khufiya aur e'laaniya infaaq karta rehta hai. To kya yeh dono baraabar ho sakte hain? Saari taareef sirf Allah ke liye hi hai, magar in logon ki aksariyat kuch nahin jaanti hai

Aur Allah ne ek aur misaal un do insaanon ki bayaan ki hai jin mein se ek goonga hai aur us ke bas mein kuch nahin hai, balke woh khud apne maula ke sar par ek bojh hai, ke jis taraf bhi bhej de koi khair le kar na aaega. To kya woh us ke baraabar ho sakta hai jo adl ka hukm deta hai aur seedhe raaste par gaamzan hai
Aasmaan o zameen ka saara ghaib Allah hi ke liye hai, aur qiyaamat ka hukm to sirf ek palak jhapakne ke baraabar ya us se bhi qareeb-tar hai, aur yaqeenan Allah har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai
Aur Allah hi ne tumhein shikam-e-maadar se is tarah nikaala hai ke tum kuch nahin jaante the, aur usi ne tumhaare liye kaan, aankh aur dil qaraar diye hain ke shaayad tum shukr-guzaar ban jaao

Kya un logon ne parindon ki taraf nahin dekha ke woh kis tarah fiza-e-aasmaan mein musakhkhar hain, ke Allah ke ilaawa unhein koi rokne waala aur sambhaalne waala nahin hai. Beshak is mein bhi us qaum ke liye bahut si nishaaniyaan hain jo imaan rakhne waali qaum hai

Aur Allah hi ne tumhaare liye tumhaare gharon ko wajh-e-sukoon banaaya hai, aur tumhaare liye jaanwaron ki khaalon se aise ghar bana diye hain jin ko tum roz-e-safar bhi halka samajhte ho aur roz-e-iqaamat bhi halka mehsoos karte ho, aur phir un ke oon, roein aur baalon se mukhtalif saamaan-e-zindagi aur ek muddat ke liye kaar-aamad cheezein bana deen

Aur Allah hi ne tumhaare liye makhlooqaat ka saaya qaraar diya hai, aur pahaadon mein chhupne ki jagahein banaayi hain, aur aise pairaahan banaaye hain jo garmi se bacha sakein, aur phir aise pairaahan banaaye hain jo hathiyaaron ki zad se bacha sakein. Woh isi tarah apni ne'maton ko tumhaare oopar tamaam kar deta hai ke shaayad tum itaa'at-guzaar ban jaao
Phir us ke baad bhi agar yeh zaalim munh pher lein to aap ka kaam sirf waazeh paighaam ka pahuncha dena hai aur bas
Yeh log Allah ki ne'mat ko pehchaante hain aur phir inkaar karte hain, aur un ki aksariyat kaafir hai
Aur qiyaamat ke din hum har ummat mein se ek gawaah laayenge, aur us ke baad kaafiron ko kisi tarah ki ijaazat na di jaaegi, aur na un ka uzr hi suna jaaega
Aur jab zaalimeen azaab ko dekh lenge to phir us mein koi takhfeef na hogi aur na inhein kisi qism ki mohlat di jaaegi

Aur jab mushrikeen apne shuraka ko dekhenge to kahenge: Parwardigar! Yahi hamaare shuraka the jinhein hum tujhe chhod kar pukaara karte the. Phir woh shuraka is baat ko unhi ki taraf phenk denge ke tum log bilkul jhoote ho
Aur phir us din Allah ki baargaah mein itaa'at ki pesh-kash karenge, aur jin baaton ka iftira kiya karte the woh sab ghaaib aur bekaar ho jaayengi
Jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya aur raah-e-Khuda mein rukaawat paida ki hum ne un ke azaab mein mazeed izaafa kar diya, ke yeh log fasaad barpa kiya karte the

Aur qiyaamat ke din hum har giroh ke khilaaf unhi mein ka ek gawaah uthaayenge, aur Paighambar! Aap ko un sab ka gawaah bana kar le aayenge. Aur hum ne aap par kitaab naazil ki hai jis mein har shai ki wazaahat maujood hai, aur yeh kitaab itaa'at-guzaaron ke liye hidaayat, rehmat aur bashaarat hai
Beshak Allah adl, ehsaan aur qaraabat-daaron ke huqooq ki adaaegi ka hukm deta hai, aur badkaari, naa-shaaista harkaat aur zulm se mana karta hai, ke shaayad tum isi tarah naseehat haasil kar lo

Aur jab koi ahd karo to Allah ke ahd ko poora karo, aur apni qasmon ko un ke istehkaam ke baad hargiz mat todo, jab ke tum Allah ko kafeel aur nigraan bana chuke ho, ke yaqeenan Allah tumhaare af'aal ko khoob jaanta hai

Aur khabardaar us aurat ke maanind na ho jaao jis ne apne dhaage ko mazboot kaatne ke baad phir use tukde tukde kar daala. Kya tum apne mu'aahide ko is chaalaaki ka zariya banaate ho ke ek giroh doosre giroh se zyaada faaida haasil kare? Allah tumhein unhi baaton ke zariye aazma raha hai, aur yaqeenan roz-e-qiyaamat us amr ki wazaahat kar dega jis mein tum aapas mein ikhtilaaf kar rahe the

Aur agar Parwardigar chaahta to jabran tum sab ko ek qaum bana deta, lekin woh ikhtiyaar de kar jise chaahta hai gumraahi mein chhod deta hai aur jise chaahta hai manzil-e-hidaayat tak pahuncha deta hai, aur tum se yaqeenan un aamaal ke baare mein sawaal kiya jaaega jo tum duniya mein anjaam de rahe the

Aur khabardaar apni qasmon ko fasaad ka zariya na banaao ke nau-muslim afraad ke qadam saabit hone ke baad phir ukhad jaayein, aur tumhein raah-e-Khuda se rokne ki paadaash mein bade azaab ka maza chakhna pade, aur tumhaare liye azaab-e-azeem ho jaaye
Aur khabardaar Allah ke ahd ke iwaz ma'mooli qeemat (maal-e-duniya) na lo, ke jo kuch Allah ke paas hai wahi tumhaare haq mein behtar hai agar tum kuch jaante boojhte ho
Jo kuch tumhaare paas hai woh sab kharch ho jaaega, aur jo kuch Allah ke paas hai wahi baaqi rehne waala hai, aur hum yaqeenan sabr karne waalon ko un ke aamaal se behtar jaza ata karenge

Jo shakhs bhi nek amal karega, woh mard ho ya aurat, ba-shart-e-ke saahib-e-imaan ho, hum use paakeeza hayaat ata karenge aur inhein un aamaal se behtar jaza denge jo woh zindagi mein anjaam de rahe the
Lihaaza jab aap Quran padhein to Shaitaan-e-Rajeem ke muqaable ke liye Allah se panaah talab karein
Shaitaan hargiz un logon par ghalaba nahin pa sakta jo saahibaan-e-imaan hain aur jin ka Allah par tawakkul aur e'timaad hai
Us ka ghalaba sirf un logon par hota hai jo use sarparast banaate hain aur Allah ke baare mein shirk karne waale hain

Aur hum jab ek aayat ki jagah par doosri aayat tabdeel karte hain, to agarche Khuda khoob jaanta hai ke woh kya naazil kar raha hai, lekin yeh log yahi kehte hain ke Muhammad! Tum iftira karne waale ho, haalaanke un ki aksariyat kuch nahin jaanti hai

To aap keh dijiye ke is Quran ko Rooh-ul-Qudus Jibraeel ne tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf se haq ke saath naazil kiya hai taake saahibaan-e-imaan ko sabaat o istiqlaal ata kare, aur yeh itaa'at-guzaaron ke liye ek hidaayat aur bashaarat hai

Aur hum khoob jaante hain ke yeh mushrikeen yeh kehte hain ke inhein koi insaan is Quran ki ta'leem de raha hai, haalaanke jis ki taraf yeh nisbat dete hain woh Ajami hai aur yeh zabaan Arabi waazeh o faseeh hai
Beshak jo log Allah ki nishaaniyon par imaan nahin laate hain Khuda inhein hidaayat bhi nahin deta hai, aur un ke liye dardnaak azaab bhi hai
Yaqeenan ghalat ilzaam lagaane waale sirf wahi afraad hote hain jo Allah ki aayaton par imaan nahin rakhte hain, aur wahi jhoote bhi hote hain

Jo shakhs bhi imaan laane ke baad kufr ikhtiyaar kar le, ilaawa us ke jo kufr par majboor kar diya jaaye aur us ka dil imaan ki taraf se mutma'in ho, aur kufr ke liye seena kushaada rakhta ho, us ke oopar Khuda ka ghazab hai aur us ke liye bahut bada azaab hai
Yeh is liye ke un logon ne zindagaani-e-duniya ko aakhirat par muqaddam kiya hai, aur Allah zaalim qaumon ko hargiz hidaayat nahin deta hai
Yahi woh log hain jin ke dilon par aur aankh kaan par kufr ki chhaap laga di gayi hai, aur yahi woh log hain jo haqeeqatan haqaaiq se ghaafil hain
Aur yaqeenan yahi log aakhirat mein ghaata uthaane waalon mein hain

Us ke baad tumhaara Parwardigar un logon ke liye jinhon ne fitnon mein mubtala hone ke baad hijrat ki hai aur phir jihaad bhi kiya hai aur sabr se bhi kaam liya hai, yaqeenan tumhaara Parwardigar bahut zyaada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Qiyaamat ka din woh din hoga jab har insaan apne nafs ki taraf se difaa' karne ke liye haazir hoga, aur nafs ko us ke amal ka poora poora badla diya jaaega, aur kisi par zulm nahin kiya jaaega

Aur Allah ne us qarya ki bhi misaal bayaan ki hai jo mahfooz aur mutma'in thi aur us ka rizq har taraf se baa-qaa'ida aa raha tha, lekin us qarya ke rehne waalon ne Allah ki ne'maton ka inkaar kiya to Khuda ne inhein bhook aur khauf ke libaas ka maza chakha diya, sirf un ke un aamaal ki bina par ke jo woh anjaam de rahe the
Aur yaqeenan un ke paas rasool aaya to unhon ne us ki takzeeb kar di, to phir un tak azaab aa pahuncha ke yeh sab zulm karne waale the
Lihaaza ab tum Allah ke diye hue rizq-e-halaal o paakeeza ko khaao, aur agar us ki ibaadat karne waale ho to us ki ne'maton ka shukriya bhi ada karte raho

Us ne tumhaare liye sirf murdaar, khoon, soor ka gosht aur jo ghair-e-Khuda ke naam par zibah kiya jaaye use haraam kar diya hai, aur is mein bhi agar koi shakhs muztar o majboor ho jaaye aur na baghaawat kare na hadd se tajaawuz kare to Khuda bahut bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Aur khabardaar jo tumhaari zabaanein ghalat-bayaani se kaam leti hain us ki bina par yeh na kaho ke yeh halaal hai aur yeh haraam hai, ke is tarah Khuda par jhoota bohtaan baandhne waale ho jaaoge, aur jo Allah par jhoota bohtaan baandhte hain un ke liye falaah aur kaamyaabi nahin hai
Yeh duniya sirf ek mukhtasar lazzat hai, aur us ke baad un ke liye bada dardnaak azaab hai
Aur hum ne Yahoodiyon ke liye un tamaam cheezon ko haraam kar diya hai jin ka tazkira hum pehle kar chuke hain, aur yeh hum ne zulm nahin kiya hai balke woh khud apne nafs par zulm karne waale the

Us ke baad tumhaara Parwardigar un logon ke liye jinhon ne naadaani mein buraaiyaan ki hain aur us ke baad tauba bhi kar li hai aur apne ko sudhaar bhi liya hai, tumhaara Parwardigar in baaton ke baad bahut bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Beshak Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ek mustaqil ummat aur Allah ke itaa'at-guzaar aur baatil se katra kar chalne waale the, aur mushrikeen mein se nahin the
Woh Allah ki ne'maton ke shukr-guzaar the, Khuda ne inhein muntakhab kiya tha aur seedhe raaste ki hidaayat di thi
Aur hum ne inhein duniya mein bhi neki ata ki, aur aakhirat mein bhi un ka shumaar nek kirdaar logon mein hoga
Us ke baad hum ne aap ki taraf wahi ki ke Ibraheem alaihis-salaam-e-Haneef ke tareeqe ka ittibaa' karein, ke woh mushrikeen mein se nahin the

Hafte ke din ki ta'zeem sirf un logon ke liye qaraar di gayi thi jo us ke baare mein ikhtilaaf kar rahe the, aur aap ka Parwardigar roz-e-qiyaamat un tamaam baaton ka faisla kar dega jin mein yeh log ikhtilaaf kar rahe hain

Aap apne Rab ke raaste ki taraf hikmat aur achchhi naseehat ke zariye daawat dein, aur un se us tareeqe se behas karein jo behtareen tareeqa hai, ke aap ka Parwardigar behtar jaanta hai ke kaun us ke raaste se behak gaya hai aur kaun log hidaayat paane waale hain
Aur agar tum un ke saath sakhti bhi karo to usi qadar jis qadar unhon ne tumhaare saath sakhti ki hai, aur agar sabr karo to sabr bahar-haal sabr karne waalon ke liye behtareen hai
Aur aap sabr hi karein ke aap ka sabr bhi Allah hi ki madad se hoga, aur un ke haal par ranjeeda na hon, aur un ki makkaariyon ki wajah se tang-dili ka bhi shikaar na hon
Beshak Allah un logon ke saath hai jinhon ne taqwa ikhtiyaar kiya hai aur jo nek amal anjaam dene waale hain
